$comment: The SMS snippets staff insert in SMS Conversations instead of retyping (README.md, snippets.json, decision 299). A snippet with no owner is shared, so every staff member sees it. An owner is a staff key in configuration/staff.json, and only that person sees the snippet, or 'campus-pastor', which gives each campus pastor in the dataset their own copy. 'category' is a Rock.Model.Snippet category's key in configuration/categories.json. A snippet with 'campusGuids' loads once per campus in the dataset, with {campus} and {serviceTimes} filled for that campus and {staff} for its campus pastor. Rock fills {{ Person.NickName }} when staff insert it. 'topics' are the topics in conversations.json where staff reply with it: in about 'replyShare' of the generated threads in those topics, the staff's first reply is the snippet's text.

snippets.name: {campus} Service Times
snippets.description: Sunday service times at Rock Solid {campus}.
snippets.text: Hi {{ Person.NickName }}! Sunday services at {campus} are at {serviceTimes}. Every service has the same message and kids rooms.

snippets.name: First Visit
snippets.description: What to expect on a first Sunday.
snippets.text: Hi {{ Person.NickName }}! Come as you are. Look for the welcome tent by the front doors, and a greeter will show you around and help check in your kids.

snippets.name: Find a Small Group
snippets.description: How to find a small group and meet its leader.
snippets.text: Hi {{ Person.NickName }}! The group finder on our website shows every small group and the night it meets. Pick one, and I'll connect you with the leader.

snippets.name: Giving Help
snippets.description: Where to give, set up a recurring gift, and find a giving statement.
snippets.text: Hi {{ Person.NickName }}! You can give, set up a recurring gift, and get your giving statement on the Give page of our website. Happy to walk you through it.

snippets.name: Lost Pickup Tag
snippets.description: How a parent picks up their kids without the pickup tag.
snippets.text: Hi {{ Person.NickName }}! No problem. Bring a photo ID to the kids check-in desk, and our team will match it to your family and bring your kids out.

snippets.name: Camp Forms
snippets.description: Where the camp form and its medical release are.
snippets.text: Hi {{ Person.NickName }}! The camp form is on the Students page of our website. A parent or guardian signs the medical release as part of it.

snippets.name: Praying for You
snippets.description: A reply to a prayer request that asks before sharing it.
snippets.text: Thank you for trusting me with this, {{ Person.NickName }}. I'm praying for you now. Is it okay to share with our prayer team, or keep it between us?

snippets.name: Baptism Next Steps
snippets.description: When the church baptizes and how to start.
snippets.text: {{ Person.NickName }}, that's amazing! We baptize at Easter and in July. Fill out the baptism interest form on our website, and we'll reach out.

snippets.name: Event Details
snippets.description: Where to find event times, places, and sign-ups.
snippets.text: Hi {{ Person.NickName }}! Times, places, and sign-ups for every event are on the Events page of our website. Text me if you can't find something.

snippets.name: Camp Packing List
snippets.description: What to bring to Student Camp.
snippets.text: Hey {{ Person.NickName }}! Pack a Bible, water bottle, sunscreen, sleeping bag, towel, swimsuit, and clothes that can get messy. See you on the bus!

snippets.name: Coffee This Week?
snippets.description: An invitation to coffee with Ted.
snippets.text: Hi {{ Person.NickName }}, it's Ted. I'd love to buy you a coffee this week and hear more of your story. Would a morning or a lunch work better for you?

snippets.name: Office Hours
snippets.description: Points a Rock question to Rock Office Hours.
snippets.text: Hi {{ Person.NickName }}! Bring that one to Rock Office Hours this month. It's on the staff calendar, and we'll work through it together.

snippets.name: Welcome to {campus}
snippets.description: A personal welcome from the {campus} campus pastor.
snippets.text: Hi {{ Person.NickName }}, it's Pastor {staff} at Rock Solid {campus}. I'd love to meet you this Sunday. Come find me in the lobby after the service.

snippets.name: Praying for Your Family
snippets.description: A personal reply from the {campus} campus pastor to a prayer request.
snippets.text: {{ Person.NickName }}, thank you for telling me. I'm praying for you and your family, and I'll check in later this week. You're not alone in this.

$accessComment: Who may see which snippet in SMS Conversations. The verify tool asks Rock each question through the snippet's own security check, which shows a personal snippet only to its owner, even to Rock's administrator. Main campus snippets only, so every dataset has them.
